scenarios.title: Search assets by partial asset name
preconditions: The Enterprise Data Catalog application is loaded.
Assets 'Customer Master', 'Sales Transactions', 'Product Reference API', and 'Supplier Data Feed' exist in the catalog.
steps: Navigate to the asset catalog search bar.
scenarios.expectedResult: The asset list displays 'Customer Master' and excludes non-matching assets.

scenarios.title: Search assets by partial owner name
preconditions: The Enterprise Data Catalog application is loaded.
Assets with owners 'Data Platform', 'Finance Data', 'Product Engineering', and 'Procurement Ops' exist.
steps: Navigate to the asset catalog search bar.
scenarios.expectedResult: The search result lists 'Sales Transactions' owned by 'Finance Data'.

scenarios.title: Verify case-insensitive search behavior
preconditions: The Enterprise Data Catalog application is loaded.
Asset 'Product Reference API' exists.
steps: Navigate to the asset catalog search bar.
Enter 'product reference api' in lower case.
scenarios.expectedResult: 'Product Reference API' is successfully returned regardless of casing.

scenarios.title: Filter assets by Table type
preconditions: The Enterprise Data Catalog application is loaded.
Catalog contains assets of types Table, API, and File.
steps: Locate the Asset Type filter dropdown/options.
scenarios.expectedResult: Only assets of type Table ('Customer Master' and 'Sales Transactions') are displayed.

scenarios.title: Filter assets by API type
preconditions: The Enterprise Data Catalog application is loaded.
Catalog contains assets of types Table, API, and File.
steps: Locate the Asset Type filter options.
scenarios.expectedResult: Only asset 'Product Reference API' of type API is displayed.

scenarios.title: Filter assets by File type
preconditions: The Enterprise Data Catalog application is loaded.
Catalog contains assets of types Table, API, and File.
steps: Locate the Asset Type filter options.
scenarios.expectedResult: Only asset 'Supplier Data Feed' of type File is displayed.

scenarios.title: Clear active filters to restore full asset listing
preconditions: The Enterprise Data Catalog application is loaded.
Asset type filter is currently applied (e.g., 'File').
scenarios.expectedResult: All filters are reset and all 4 catalog assets ('Customer Master', 'Sales Transactions', 'Product Reference API', 'Supplier Data Feed') are displayed.

scenarios.title: View details of a selected asset
preconditions: The Enterprise Data Catalog application is loaded.
Asset list contains 'Supplier Data Feed'.
steps: Locate 'Supplier Data Feed' in the asset catalog.
Select/click on 'Supplier Data Feed' to view details.
scenarios.expectedResult: Asset details view opens showing details for 'Supplier Data Feed', owner 'Procurement Ops', and type 'File'.

scenarios.title: Search for non-existent asset name or owner
preconditions: The Enterprise Data Catalog application is loaded.
steps: Navigate to the asset catalog search bar.
scenarios.expectedResult: No assets are returned and an empty state or 'no results found' message is displayed.

scenarios.title: Search with single character search query
preconditions: The Enterprise Data Catalog application is loaded.
scenarios.expectedResult: Assets matching 'Data' in name or owner ('Customer Master', 'Supplier Data Feed') are returned.

scenarios.title: Search asset name with leading and trailing whitespace
preconditions: The Enterprise Data Catalog application is loaded.
Asset 'Sales Transactions' exists.
steps: Enter '   Sales Transactions   ' with leading and trailing spaces.
scenarios.expectedResult: Whitespace is trimmed automatically and 'Sales Transactions' asset is successfully returned.
